claim: Signal is Coco Research's open design language: three editions, CSS tokens and layout documentation.
Three editions with first-class light paper and dark stage tokens across desktop and phone viewports.
Archivo and Martian Mono variable typography scale with tabular numerals for counts and baselines.
Zero runtime network requests, analytics beacons or tracking scripts in page stylesheets and scripts.
Native prefers-reduced-motion rules disable transitions and WebGL motion cleanly.
Details soon for upcoming design-language milestones; the standalone repository is not checked out locally.
Source available: Apache-2.0-licensed CSS and documentation on GitHub, with no packaged release today.
